observations: Two separate sewing machine stands are shown.
The stands have ornate, cast-iron style frames.
One stand has a blue painted top surface with a wave pattern.
The other stand has a brown wood-grain patterned top surface.
A metal ruler is placed on the blue top in photo 2, showing measurements up to 28 inches.
The stands have a metal foot pedal and a metal wire wheel.
The stands are placed on a cracked concrete surface outdoors.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The stands may be missing the actual sewing machines.
risks.proof: Photos of the two machines sitting on the stands.

risks.risk: The motor may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running and the needle moving.

risks.risk: The metal surfaces may be rusted or pitted.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the metal surfaces.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual sewing machines on the stands.
A video of the motor running.
Close-up photos of the metal surfaces to check for rust.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as sewing machine stands. They can be priced at their worst-case value (empty stands, non-functional) until further proof of the machines and motor operation is provided.
